    :root {
      color-scheme: dark;
      --night: #06030f;
      --panel: rgba(18, 10, 36, .78);
      --panel-strong: rgba(25, 13, 49, .94);
      --purple: #a875ff;
      --purple-soft: #d9c2ff;
      --gold: #f2cf72;
      --gold-soft: #fff0b3;
      --ink: #f7f0ff;
      --muted: #b5a8ca;
      --line: rgba(197, 157, 255, .22);
      --green: #48e6a0;
      --amber: #ffb84a;
      --red: #ff4d68;
      --shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, .48);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      color: var(--ink);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 18% 10%, rgba(117, 56, 198, .2), transparent 27rem),
        radial-gradient(circle at 82% 20%, rgba(232, 180, 76, .1), transparent 25rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #090414 0%, var(--night) 52%, #04020a 100%);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    body::before,
    body::after {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -2;
      pointer-events: none;
      content: "";
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,.8) 0 1px, transparent 1.5px),
        radial-gradient(circle, rgba(211,180,255,.56) 0 1px, transparent 1.5px),
        radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,220,136,.46) 0 1px, transparent 1.5px);
      background-position: 0 0, 41px 67px, 93px 21px;
      background-size: 139px 139px, 173px 173px, 211px 211px;
      opacity: .48;
    }

    body::after {
      z-index: -1;
      opacity: .24;
      filter: blur(.2px);
      transform: scale(1.12);
      animation: drift 22s linear infinite alternate;
    }

    button, input { font: inherit; }
    button { cursor: pointer; }
    a { color: inherit; }

    .shell {
      width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 32px));
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 34px 0 72px;
    }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 18px;
      margin-bottom: 34px;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      color: var(--gold-soft);
      font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      display: grid;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 207, 114, .5);
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(242, 207, 114, .08);
      box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(242, 207, 114, .18);
      font-size: 21px;
    }

    .source-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      padding: 8px 11px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: rgba(10, 5, 22, .7);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .source-badge::before {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #85809a;
      content: "";

    (() => {

      const signs = [
        ["♈", "Aries of the Hotfix"],

        ["♊", "Gemini of the Merge Conflict"],
        ["♋", "Cancer of the Legacy Module"],
        ["♌", "Leo of the Launch"],

        ["♏", "Scorpio of the Rollback"],
        ["♐", "Sagittarius of the Feature Flag"],
        ["♑", "Capricorn of the Build Pipeline"],
        ["♒", "Aquarius of the Refactor"],
        ["♓", "Pisces of the Promise Chain"]
      ];

      const dangerousWords = ["fix", "hotfix", "revert", "please work"];
      const vagueMessages = new Set(["update", "updates", "changes", "wip", "stuff", "misc", "test", "temp"]);

      function escapeHtml(value) {
        const node = document.createElement("div");
        node.textContent = String(value ?? "");
        return node.innerHTML;
      }

      function formatDate(value) {
        return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
          dateStyle: "medium",
          timeStyle: "short"
        }).format(new Date(value));
      }

      function clip(value, length = 60) {
        const text = String(value ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        return text.length > length ? text.slice(0, length - 1) + "…" : text;
      }

      function keywordCount(messages, pattern) {
        return messages.reduce((sum, message) => sum + (pattern.test(message) ? 1 : 0), 0);
      }

      function analyze(commits) {
        const messages = commits.map((item) => item.message.toLowerCase());
        const triggerCounts = Object.fromEntries(
          dangerousWords.map((word) => [word, messages.filter((message) => message.includes(word)).length])
        );
        const dangerCount = Object.values(triggerCounts).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
        const mergeCount = keywordCount(messages, /\bmerge\b/);
        const featureCount = keywordCount(messages, /\b(feat|feature|add|implement|introduce)\b/);
        const docsCount = keywordCount(messages, /\b(doc|docs|readme|guide)\b/);
        const refactorCount = keywordCount(messages, /\b(refactor|chore|cleanup|polish)\b/);
        const testCount = keywordCount(messages, /\b(test|spec|coverage)\b/);
        const vagueCount = messages.filter((message) => {
          const first = message.split("\n")[0].trim();
          return first.length < 7 || vagueMessages.has(first);
        }).length;

        const times = commits.map((item) => new Date(item.date).getTime()).filter(Number.isFinite).sort((a, b) => a - b);
        const spanHours = times.length > 1 ? Math.max(0, (times[times.length - 1] - times[0]) / 36e5) : 0;
        const byDay = {};
        commits.forEach((item) => {
          const key = new Date(item.date).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
          byDay[key] = (byDay[key] || 0) + 1;
        });
        const peakDay = Math.max(0, ...Object.values(byDay));
        const burst = peakDay >= 6 || (commits.length >= 10 && spanHours <= 24);
        const chaosScore = Math.min(99, dangerCount * 18 + vagueCount * 6 + (burst ? 24 : 0) + Math.max(0, peakDay - 3) * 3);
        const authors = new Set(commits.map((item) => item.author).filter(Boolean)).size;
        const days = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(spanHours / 24));

        let mood = "green";
        let moodLabel = "Calm & Clear";
        let moodDetail = "The branches move with measured purpose. No emergency words disturb the commit sky.";
        if (dangerCount > 0) {
          mood = "red";
          moodLabel = "Deep Red Alarm";
          moodDetail = `${dangerCount} emergency omen${dangerCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} invoked fix, hotfix, revert, or “please work.” The orb demands snacks and a rollback plan.`;
        } else if (burst || vagueCount >= 4 || chaosScore >= 30) {
          mood = "amber";
          moodLabel = "Amber Chaos";
          moodDetail = `The repository moves in restless bursts: ${peakDay} commits on its busiest day and ${vagueCount} cryptic message${vagueCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`;
        }

        const zodiacSeed =
          mergeCount * 7 +
          featureCount * 5 +
          dangerCount * 11 +
          docsCount * 3 +
          refactorCount * 9 +
          testCount * 4 +
          vagueCount * 2 +
          commits.length;
        const zodiacIndex = zodiacSeed % signs.length;

        return {
          triggerCounts,
          dangerCount,
          mergeCount,
          featureCount,
          docsCount,
          refactorCount,
          testCount,
          vagueCount,
          spanHours,
          peakDay,
          burst,
          chaosScore,
          authors,
          days,
          mood,
          moodLabel,
          moodDetail,
          zodiacIndex,
          zodiacSeed
        };
      }

      function interpretation(message) {
        const lower = message.toLowerCase();
        if (/\b(revert|rollback)\b/.test(lower)) return "The timeline folds upon itself; an ancestor commit has returned.";
        if (/\b(hotfix|fix|bug)\b/.test(lower)) return "A wounded branch has been bound, though the scar still glows.";
        if (/\b(merge|pull request)\b/.test(lower)) return "Two rivers of code meet beneath a cautious moon.";
        if (/\b(feat|feature|add|implement|introduce)\b/.test(lower)) return "A new constellation enters the product sky.";
        if (/\b(refactor|cleanup|polish|chore)\b/.test(lower)) return "The old stones are rearranged so future travelers may pass.";
        if (/\b(test|spec|coverage)\b/.test(lower)) return "The code submits itself to trial before the celestial court.";
        if (/\b(doc|docs|readme|guide)\b/.test(lower)) return "The scribes illuminate a path that was once known only by rumor.";
        if (/\b(deploy|release|ship)\b/.test(lower)) return "The vessel approaches production waters under a watchful star.";
        return "A quiet star shifts position; its meaning will surface at the next code review.";
      }

      function renderHoroscope(commits, analysis) {
        const fragments = commits.slice(0, 3).map((item) => `“${clip(item.message, 52)}”`);
        const first = fragments[0] || "an unnamed change";
        const second = fragments[1] || "a silent branch";
        const third = fragments[2] || "the patient build";
        $("horoscope").textContent =
          `Attend, keeper of branches. The stars first whisper ${first}; nearby, ${second} crosses the mainline like a silver comet. ` +
          `Let ${third} be thy lantern. ${analysis.mood === "red" ? "Do not mistake urgency for destiny." : "The repository favors deliberate hands today."}`;
        $("mercury-warning").textContent =
          `Mock warning: Mercury is in retrograde. Before deploying, ask CI for three green signs and ensure the rollback scroll is within reach. This prophecy is fictional.`;
      }

      function renderEvidence(analysis, commits) {
        const spanText = analysis.spanHours < 24
          ? `${analysis.spanHours.toFixed(1)} hours`
          : `${analysis.days} days`;
        const items = [
          ["Emergency words", String(analysis.dangerCount)],
          ["Vague messages", String(analysis.vagueCount)],
          ["Busiest day", `${analysis.peakDay} commits`],
          ["Commit span", spanText],
          ["Zodiac formula", `${analysis.zodiacSeed} mod 12 = ${analysis.zodiacIndex}`]
        ];
        $("evidence").innerHTML = items.map(([label, value]) =>
          `<div><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span><strong>${escapeHtml(value)}</strong></div>`
        ).join("");
      }

      function renderOmens(commits) {
        $("omens").innerHTML = commits.map((item) => `
          <article class="omen">
            <a class="sha" href="${escapeHtml(item.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label="Open commit ${escapeHtml(item.shortSha)} on GitHub">${escapeHtml(item.shortSha)}</a>
            <div>
              <p class="commit-message">${escapeHtml(item.message)}</p>
              <p class="commit-meta">${escapeHtml(item.author)} · ${escapeHtml(formatDate(item.date))}</p>
            </div>
            <p class="interpretation">${escapeHtml(interpretation(item.message))}</p>
          </article>
        `).join("");
      }

      function renderReading(commits, owner, repo) {
        const analysis = analyze(commits);
        const [symbol, name] = signs[analysis.zodiacIndex];
        const orb = $("orb");
        orb.className = `orb ${analysis.mood}`;
        orb.setAttribute("aria-label", `${analysis.moodLabel} repository mood`);
        $("mood-label").textContent = analysis.moodLabel;
        $("mood-detail").textContent = analysis.moodDetail;
        $("zodiac-symbol").textContent = symbol;
        $("zodiac-name").textContent = name;
        $("zodiac-reason").textContent =
          `Chosen from the observable mix of ${analysis.featureCount} feature, ${analysis.mergeCount} merge, ` +
          `${analysis.refactorCount} refactor, ${analysis.testCount} test, and ${analysis.dangerCount} emergency-word commits.`;
        $("stat-commits").textContent = String(commits.length);
        $("stat-authors").textContent = String(analysis.authors);
        $("stat-days").textContent = String(analysis.days);
        $("stat-chaos").textContent = String(analysis.chaosScore);
        $("omens-title").textContent =
          `${commits.length} ${commits.length === 1 ? "Omen" : "Omens"}`;
        renderHoroscope(commits, analysis);
        renderEvidence(analysis, commits);
        renderOmens(commits);
        reading.classList.add("visible");
        sourceBadge.className = "source-badge live";
        sourceBadge.textContent = `Live GitHub MCP · ${owner}/${repo}`;
        status.textContent = `${commits.length} real commits consulted. The reading is ready.`;
      }

      async function fetchCommits(owner, repo) {
        if (!window.archestra?.tools?.call) {
          throw new Error("The Archestra Apps SDK is unavailable.");
        }
        await window.archestra.ready;
        const result = await window.archestra.tools.call(
          "repo_oracle_github__get_recent_commits",
          { owner, repo, limit: 20 }
        );
        const data = result?.commits;
        if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
          throw new Error("The GitHub MCP tool returned no commits.");
        }
        return data.slice(0, 20).map((item) => ({
          sha: String(item.sha || ""),
          shortSha: String(item.short_sha || item.sha || "").slice(0, 7),
          message: String(item.message || "Untitled commit").split("\n")[0],
          author: String(item.author || "Unknown author"),
          date: item.date || new Date().toISOString(),
          url: item.url || `https://github.com/${owner}/${repo}/commit/${item.sha}`
        }));
      }

      async function consult(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const owner = $("owner").value.trim();
        const repo = $("repo").value.trim();
        if (!owner || !repo) return;

        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = "Reading the Stars…";
        loading.classList.add("visible");
        loading.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
        errorBox.style.display = "none";
        reading.classList.remove("visible");
        sourceBadge.className = "source-badge";
        sourceBadge.textContent = "Consulting GitHub";
        status.textContent = `Fetching the latest 20 commits from ${owner}/${repo}…`;

        try {
          const commits = await fetchCommits(owner, repo);
          renderReading(commits, owner, repo);
          setTimeout(() => reading.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" }), 120);
        } catch (error) {
          const message = String(error?.message || error);
          errorBox.innerHTML =
            `<strong>The veil remained closed.</strong><br>${escapeHtml(message)}<br>` +
            `The read-only MCP server supports public repositories only and stores no GitHub credentials.`;
          errorBox.style.display = "block";
          sourceBadge.textContent = "Reading unavailable";
          status.textContent = "No synthetic data was substituted.";
        } finally {
          button.disabled = false;
          button.textContent = "Consult the Oracle";
          loading.classList.remove("visible");
          loading.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        }
      }

      form.addEventListener("submit", consult);
      $("another").addEventListener("click", () => {
        reading.classList.remove("visible");
        errorBox.style.display = "none";
        sourceBadge.className = "source-badge";
        sourceBadge.textContent = "Awaiting consultation";
        status.textContent = "Choose another public GitHub repository.";
        $("owner").focus();
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
      });
    })();
  </script>


</body><grammarly-desktop-integration data-grammarly-shadow-root="true" style="visibility: visible !important;"></grammarly-desktop-integration></html>

enhancement.prompt: Build me an app that takes a GitHub repository name or URL and shows me a summary of its recent commits, including the repository name, total commit count, and the latest commit messages fetched directly from GitHub.

I've built **The Repo Oracle**, an interactive GitHub repository analyzer that inspects commit histories and repository activity.

- Fetch recent commits from any public GitHub repository using GitHub's repository tools
- View structured summaries including repository names, total commit counts, and recent commit messages
- Inspect commit details and track recent changes across releases and updates
- Query repository commit logs on demand with customizable limits

Just enter a GitHub repository path like `owner/repo` or ask me to fetch commit information for you.
